crossRefs.note: He had forty sons and thirty sons’ sons who rode on seventy donkey colts. He judged Israel eight years.
He had thirty sons who rode on thirty donkey colts. They had thirty cities, which are called Havvoth Jair to this day…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: He had thirty sons. He sent his thirty daughters outside his clan, and he brought in thirty daughters from outside his clan for his sons. He judged Israel seven years.
translations.bsb: He had thirty sons, as well as thirty daughters whom he gave in marriage to men outside his clan; and for his sons he brought back thirty wives from elsewhere. Ibzan judged Israel seven years.
translations.kjv: And he had thirty sons, and thirty daughters, whom he sent abroad, and took in thirty daughters from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
translations.asv: And he had thirty sons; and thirty daughters he sent abroad, and thirty daughters he brought in from abroad for his sons. And he judged Israel seven years.
